identification: Sleipnir Windows Performance Engine 3.23.0.0, PS2EXE .NET GUI wrapper
verdict_reason: Visible user-selected tuning, backups, history and recovery fit the advertised purpose; no covert payload, theft or remote control found.
scope: Static reverse engineering only; specimen was not executed.

packaging.main_trace: CreateRunspace -> GetExecutingAssembly -> GetManifestResourceStream -> UTF8 ReadToEnd -> AddScript -> asynchronous pipeline invocation; -extract writes the same source without running it.
packaging.wrapper_review: All 120 method definitions enumerated; IL bodies recovered. Host credential prompts, keyboard input and reflection are PS2EXE UI support, consistent with upstream, rather than secret harvesting.
packaging.resources: Native resources are ten PNG icons, icon group, version metadata and requireAdministrator manifest. The 7168-byte overlay exactly equals the certificate directory; no appended payload.
packaging.obfuscation: Managed script is plaintext, not encrypted. Base64 encodes backed-up StartupApproved registry values. ScriptBlock construction generates local tweak closures. XOR-decoded scanner candidates are speculative transforms of visible code/data, with no corresponding decoder execution path.
packaging.signature: PE Authenticode digest matches; signing cryptography verifies, with a valid DigiCert timestamp. Leaf is self-issued CN=Sleipnir Local Publisher, so system trust-chain verification fails. Integrity does not authenticate a trusted publisher.

execution_paths: Startup creates local state directories, defines tweak records, builds WPF UI and reads system status. It does not automatically run a tuning profile.

Mode button -> Invoke-ModeRun -> Invoke-ProfileRun -> Invoke-TweakApply: compat check, prior-state backup, apply closure, state verification and history. Maximum mode additionally asks for confirmation.

Gaming/Maximum profiles set HVCI Enabled=0, tune services/network/power and exclude configured game directories and game process names from Defender scanning. Maximum also disables hypervisor/VBS and changes CPU speculation mitigation override values.
Kill lists name game launchers, chat, sync and productivity processes. Startup controls change StartupApproved values for existing entries, rather than install this application for autorun.
Opt-in DNS control sets Cloudflare resolvers 1.1.1.1/1.0.0.1 and supports restore. Cleanup targets caches/temp/reports/game leftovers, not credential stores.
FocusGuard compiles embedded C#: foreground event hook minimizes intrusive new windows and restores the selected game window; no keystroke recording or injection.

Driver installer button confirms with the user, downloads configured HTTPS URL, requires Valid Authenticode status and expected NVIDIA/Intel publisher, then a successful restore point, before launching the downloaded path. Redirect host restrictions asserted in comments are not enforced by the code.

The IRM-to-IEX self-elevation fallback is unreachable for the admin-manifest executable and additionally guarded against its unconfigured REPLACE-WITH URL. It is latent pipeline text, not an active C2 channel.

external_checks.ps2exe: Fetched https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MScholtes/PS2EXE/master/Module/ps2exe.ps1 and compared host/resource loading and UI support code. Upstream https://github.com/MScholtes/PS2EXE documents the same wrapper modes.
external_checks.nvidia: https://www.nvidia.com/Download/index.aspx resolves to the official driver selection webpage, not an installer; downloaded HTML would fail the signature gate.
external_checks.intel: https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/support/detect.html serves Intel Driver & Support Assistant HTML; not an executable installer.
external_checks.amd: https://drivers.amd.com/drivers/whql-amd-software-adrenalin-edition-26.9.1-win11-b.exe returned 302 to AMD Download-Incomplete.html; follow-up transfer timed out. No installer was available to analyze. AMD path opens the URL in the browser rather than silent installing.
external_checks.corpus_pages: Bazaar and VirusTotal pages were not accessible with the web tool; external 24/71 detections and collection context are the user-provided evidence.

provenance_assessment: PS2EXE packaging, self-signing, admin execution, policy-bypass strings, HVCI/VBS/CPU mitigation reductions and Defender process exclusions plausibly explain generic Lazy/Agent/ML detections and malware-corpus collection. The actual collection reason and whether it was deployed without consent are unknown. No hostile deployment scenario is assumed; BENIGN is a sighted-quarantine judgment, not a trusted-software certification.
changes: Require complete CLR SHA256 type/provider names in .text; certificate SHA256 labels no longer imply a .NET API. Existing C# hashing operation rule retains source operation coverage.

Relocate IRM-to-IEX text from process/deploy/file-exec to process/deploy/script-eval, preserving matcher/scope/exclusions; update its sole exact consumer. No broad ancestor-selector consumers were found for the moved leaf.

Relocate generic .Invoke( syntax to metadata/lang/source/syntax/call; remove misleading pipeline claim and inappropriate context downgrades. PowerShell-host inference now uses CreateRunspace instead of any unrelated Invoke call.
Add notable DNS resolver-address configuration command coverage.
Add notable embedded C# SetWinEventHook native declaration coverage, complementary to the existing exact CLR member-name matcher.
Retain the accurate suspicious Defender process-exclusion mutation trait; zero hostile traits fire.

validation.focused_controls: 12 positive and near-miss static controls passed; generated inert PE fixtures are never executed. See check.py.
validation.required_final_check: make validate is run after rescanning and writing the judgment marker.
